# GROOVE POP: POST-APOCALYPTIC SURVIVAL AESTHETIC
## 20 Themed Prompts - Fashion Editorial Vision

### Set 1: Wasteland Scavenger
20 year old seductive Black woman with large chest and thick natural hair grown wild into long locs (reaching mid-back) that haven't been maintained in months - some are unraveling at the ends, some have debris tangled in them (bits of fabric, wire), the whole mass is dusty and sun-bleached from black to reddish-brown at the tips, currently tied back in a massive ponytail with actual rope, loose pieces sticking out everywhere like a lion's mane. She wears a patchwork vest made from different leather scraps (jacket leather, boot leather, couch leather) in varying shades of brown and black, stitched together with visible crude hand-stitching using wire and twine, worn over a tank top that was once white but is now permanently gray-brown, with holes along the hem. Pants are men's cargo pants in desert tan, way too big, held up with a climbing harness repurposed as a belt with carabiners holding tools, pants stuffed into mismatched boots - left foot has a scuffed brown work boot, right foot has a black combat boot, neither laced properly, just tied loose. 

Goggles pushed up on her forehead (motorcycle goggles with cracked lens), bandana around her neck (faded red paisley), fingerless gloves made from cutting fingers off winter gloves, multiple watches on one wrist (none working, just collected), necklace made from bottle caps and bullet casings, one ear has multiple piercings with random objects through them - a safety pin, a bent nail, a piece of wire.

She crouches on top of a rusted car examining something in her hands (maybe a found treasure), one foot on the roof, one on the hood, body language is alert and ready to run, head turned looking over her shoulder at the camera with suspicious eyes - she doesn't trust anyone. Background: junkyard wasteland with piles of rusted metal, abandoned cars, desert landscape, dust in the air.

Makeup is survival-nonexistent: face is dirty with actual dirt smudges, sunburn on nose and cheeks that's peeling, chapped lips with no product (cracked and dry), no eye makeup but her lashes are naturally dark and coated in dust, eyebrows are wild and unshaped, a healing cut across her cheekbone, bruise yellowing on her jaw, she looks like someone who's been surviving not styling.

Rusty text logo "GROOVE POP" made from scrap metal letters welded together, various metals creating different brown rust tones, looks like it was salvaged from old store signs, bolted onto corrugated metal.

Harsh desert sunlight creating strong shadows, dust particles visible in air catching light, everything has an orange-brown cast from the dust, one strong backlight creating rim light, extremely high contrast.

She wears a stained wife-beater tank in yellowed white tucked into high-waisted military surplus pants in olive drab with all the pockets, held up with actual electrical cable as a belt threaded through the loops, pants bloused into laced-up lineman boots (the kind electrical workers wear) in dirty tan leather with steel toes and thick rubber soles.

Welding mask pushed up on top of her head, leather work gloves tucked into her waistband, tool belt hanging low on her hips with actual tools - wire strippers, multitool, duct tape, LED flashlight. She's captured mid-run through an abandoned building, one foot on a concrete ledge, one in the air, body leaned forward in motion, one arm bent at elbow for balance, the other reaching forward, face showing intense focus and determination - she's running from or toward something.
